parameters.help_en: The purpose or objective of the data change. This parameter is used to help reduce unnecessary communication
parameters.help_zh: 业务背景，以减少沟通成本
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The stakeholders of the data change. All stakeholders can view the ticket details and assist in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than DMS administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details
parameters.name: related_user_list

fields.help_en: The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to change data. This parameter is not supported
fields.help_zh: 变更SQL附件Key，暂不支持该参数
fields.name: attachment_name

fields.help_en: The reason for the data change
fields.name: classify

fields.help_en:
The ID of the database. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

To obtain the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
To obtain the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
fields.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
fields.name: db_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database
fields.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值如下：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库
fields.name: logic

fields.help_en: The databases in which you want to change data
fields.name: db_item_list

fields.help_en:
The execution mode of the ticket after the ticket is approved. Valid values:

COMMITOR: The data change is performed by the user who submits the ticket.
AUTO: The data change is automatically performed after the ticket is approved.
LAST_AUDITOR: The data change is performed by the last approver of the ticket
fields.help_zh:
工单执行方式，取值如下：

COMMITOR : 审批通过后，提交者执行。
AUTO : 审批通过后，自动执行。
LAST_AUDITOR : 审批通过后，最后一个审批人执行
fields.name: exec_mode

fields.help_en: The SQL statements that you want to execute to change data
fields.name: exec_sql

fields.help_en: The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to roll back the data change
fields.help_zh: 回滚SQL附件Key，暂不支持该参数
fields.name: rollback_attachment_name

fields.help_en: The SQL statements used to roll back the data change
fields.name: rollback_sql

fields.help_en:
The format of the SQL statements used to roll back the data change. Valid values:

TEXT: text
ATTACHMENT: attachment. This value is not supported
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL的提交方式，取值：
TEXT：文本
ATTACHMENT：附件，暂不支持
fields.name: rollback_sql_type

fields.help_en:
The format of the SQL statements used to change data. Valid values:

TEXT: text
ATTACHMENT: attachment. This value is not supported
fields.help_zh:
变更SQL的提交方式，取值如下：
TEXT：文本
ATTACHMENT：附件，暂不支持
fields.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en: The key of the attachment that provides more instructions for the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter
parameters.help_zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: attachment_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user who actually invokes the API.<props="china">For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html。</props>
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
